skill.name: altllm-portal-billing
skill.description: Use this skill when the user asks to inspect AltLLM Portal balance, redeem a promo code, review billing transactions, or view usage analytics by period, model, or API key using the local altllm CLI. Do NOT use for API key lifecycle management or payment-link execution.
skill.summary: Inspect AltLLM Portal balance, promo codes, transactions, and usage analytics through the local CLI.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: The hardcoded URL findings are benign documentation for the intended AltLLM Portal API endpoint. The external command findings are false positives from Markdown inline code, but the sibling `../_shared` references are confirmed boundary-crossing filesystem risks. No prompt injection attempt or hidden exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The skill references shared setup files outside its own directory.
remediation.suggestion: Move the required setup guidance into this skill or package it under the skill directory with relative links that do not use `../`.

remediation.issue: Network side effects are implied by command examples.
remediation.suggestion: State clearly that billing commands contact platform-api.altllm.ai and use the saved Portal session token.

content.value_statement: Teams need quick visibility into AltLLM Portal credit, billing activity, and usage. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through local CLI checks.
actual_capabilities: Checks current Portal credit, balance expiry, and allowed model access.
Redeems promo codes through the local altllm CLI.
Reviews billing transactions with page, limit, and type filters.
Summarizes current calendar-month usage from Portal.
Groups usage by day, model, or API key with supported date filters.
limitations: Requires a local altllm CLI checkout and a saved Portal session token.
Does not manage API key creation, deletion, or rotation.
Does not execute payment links or implement plan billing logic.
History commands may return raw Portal API data that needs interpretation.

use_cases.title: Check Remaining Credit
use_cases.description: Confirm current balance, expiry details, and allowed models before running paid workloads.

use_cases.title: Review Billing Activity
use_cases.description: Inspect transaction history with filters for usage, credits, or other billing events.

use_cases.title: Analyze Portal Usage
use_cases.description: Compare usage by date, model, or API key during gateway metering checks.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Balance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use altllm-portal-billing to show my current Portal balance, expiry details, and allowed models.

prompt_templates.title: Redeem A Promo Code
prompt_templates.prompt: Use altllm-portal-billing to redeem this promo code and summarize the Portal response: PROMO-XXXX.

prompt_templates.title: Review Recent Transactions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use altllm-portal-billing to list recent billing transactions with a limit of 20 and explain the main activity.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Usage Dimensions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use altllm-portal-billing to review this month by timeline, model, and API key, then identify the largest usage drivers.

output_examples.input: Show my current Portal balance and allowed models.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes remaining credit, expiry information, and model access returned by Portal.
The response highlights transaction count, paging details, and notable usage charges without changing billing settings.

output_examples.input: Compare this month's usage by model and API key.
output_examples.output: The response lists the largest model and key contributors, then notes date filters used for the report.

best_practices: Confirm the target Portal session before running billing commands.
Use explicit month or date-range filters for repeatable usage analysis.
Summarize raw Portal responses before sharing them with nontechnical stakeholders.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for API key lifecycle management.
Do not run promo redemption without confirming the code and account.
Do not treat raw transaction output as final accounting records without review.

faq.question: What does this skill inspect?
faq.answer: It inspects AltLLM Portal balance, promo redemption, billing transactions, and usage analytics through the local CLI.

faq.question: Does it need an authenticated session?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented commands use the saved Portal session token from the local environment.

faq.question: Can it create or delete API keys?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly excludes API key lifecycle management.

faq.question: Can it execute payment links?
faq.answer: No. It is for inspection, promo redemption, and usage review, not payment-link execution.

faq.question: Which usage views are supported?
faq.answer: It supports summary, timeline, model grouping, and API key grouping.

faq.question: Can it filter usage by date?
faq.answer: Yes. Usage commands support a month filter or a complete start and end date range.
